recommendation: Keep the published source commit. It completes the current-core application of FHIR-24698 by making the in-build terminology server CapabilityStatement accurately declare the required operations; handle future TerminologyCapabilities model changes under their own issue workflow.
issue_request: FHIR-24698 was a Published/Persuasive Vocabulary change request for R5 asking for normative terminology service requirements, a replacement terminology server CapabilityStatement, and a TerminologyCapabilities example that reflects the approved minimum terminology server capabilities.
initial_application: The FHIR-24698 implementation commits added the terminology service conformance text, replaced the terminology server CapabilityStatement, and added/listed a TerminologyCapabilities example. Current source retained those changes, but the CapabilityStatement example still named several required operations as expand while their definitions pointed to lookup, validate-code, subsumes, or translate.
additional_context: CapabilityStatement and TerminologyCapabilities are active current resources in source/fhir.ini, and the terminology server CapabilityStatement is listed in the CapabilityStatement examples list. Later FHIR-28499 explains the current codeSystem.content requirement in the terminology capabilities expectations. Later FHIR-41175 explains the current sourceSystem wording for ConceptMap $translate. FHIR-56099 is a later Resolved - change required TerminologyCapabilities proposal and was not applied in this default Applied/Published seed scope.
reconciliation: Changed source/capabilitystatement/capabilitystatement-terminology-server.xml so CodeSystem operations are named lookup, validate-code, and subsumes; the ValueSet validate-code operation is named validate-code; and the ConceptMap operation is named translate. The already-correct ValueSet expand operation was left unchanged.
source_changes: source/capabilitystatement/capabilitystatement-terminology-server.xml: corrected required operation name values to match CodeSystem-lookup, CodeSystem-validate-code, CodeSystem-subsumes, ValueSet-validate-code, and ConceptMap-translate OperationDefinition references.

related_jiras.note: Added TerminologyCapabilities.codeSystem.content and explains why the current terminology service page includes codeSystem.content beyond the original FHIR-24698 wording.
Renamed ConceptMap $translate source-side parameters to sourceSystem/sourceVersion; an existing combined-branch reconciliation already updated related terminology-service wording.
Proposes renaming TerminologyCapabilities.codeSystem.version.code, but it is only Resolved - change required and was not part of this default source-edit scope.
